Look at the trouble these perpetual agitators are causing once again, trying to undermine our national order and disrupt the continuity of governance under the guise of political posturing. Former Zengeza West legislator Job Sikhala held a press conference to call for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. 

Instead of respecting authority, upholding traditional values, and focusing on the stability of the nation, these individuals are out to fracture our institutions. We desperately need strong, steady leadership and respect for the established legal process, not this constant grandstanding that threatens social cohesion. We must stand firm for order and continuity against those who only know how to fracture our society.
